channel.title: SOS Infante
channel.description: SOS Infante is a nonprofit working to prevent and respond to physical, psychological and sexual violence against children. It runs a donation center in South Florida and delivers care on the ground in Quito, Ecuador and Valera, Venezuela.

item.title: SOS Infante reopens: Miami, Quito and Valera
item.description: We are back with three cities, five active programs and one commitment: every dollar is reported by program and by city.

item.title: Why we are opening in Valera, Venezuela
item.description: Trujillo state concentrates children made vulnerable by migration, malnutrition and domestic violence, with almost no free mental health care available.

item.title: How to recognize the warning signs of child abuse
item.description: A short, practical guide: physical signs, behavioral signs, signs in the environment, and what to do in the first 24 hours.
